name: calendar
description: Persistenter Kalender (add/list/upcoming/get/update/delete) in der plugin-eigenen SQLite-DB, getrennt von der Hauptdatenbank. Termine haben Titel, Kategorie (work/private/important), Start/Ende (ISO), optional Ganztags, Ort und Beschreibung. Ein Termin kann optional eine automatische Aktion auslösen (task/prompt/workflow/coding), die über einen einmaligen Cronjob zur Startzeit ausgeführt wird.

action.description: add = Termin anlegen, list = Termine (optional gefiltert), upcoming = die nächsten Termine ab jetzt, get = ein Termin per id, update = Termin ändern, delete = Termin löschen

category.description: Kategorie; bei list zusätzlich als Filter nutzbar

start.description: Startzeit als ISO-String, z. B. 2026-08-10T10:00 (Pflicht bei add)

actionRef.description: Referenz der Aktion: Task-ID, Workflow-ID, Skill-Slug/Tool-Name oder Coding-Ziel

actionPayload.description: Optionales JSON-Payload der Aktion (z. B. Prompt-Text oder Tool-Input) als String

cronjobId.description: Verknüpfte Cronjob-id (wird von der Oberfläche gesetzt); null zum Entfernen

from.description: list-Filter: nur Termine ab diesem ISO-Datum

to.description: list-Filter: nur Termine bis zu diesem ISO-Datum

script: const s = toolContext.storage; if (!s) return { error: 'plugin storage not enabled' }; await s.exec('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, start TEXT NOT NULL, end TEXT, all_day INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, location TEXT, description TEXT, action_type TEXT, action_ref TEXT, action_payload TEXT, cronjob_id INTEGER, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)'); for (const col of ['action_type TEXT', 'action_ref TEXT', 'action_payload TEXT', 'cronjob_id INTEGER']) { try { await s.exec('ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN ' + col); } catch (e) {} } const action = String(toolInput.action || '').toLowerCase(); const now = new Date().toISOString(); const cats = ['work', 'private', 'important']; const acts = ['none', 'task', 'prompt', 'workflow', 'coding']; const normCat = (c) => cats.includes(String(c)) ? String(c) : 'work'; const normAct = (a) => acts.includes(String(a)) ? String(a) : 'none'; if (action === 'add') { const title = String(toolInput.title || '').trim(); if (!title) return { error: 'title is required for action=add' }; const start = String(toolInput.start || '').trim(); if (!start) return { error: 'start is required for action=add (ISO datetime, e.g. 2026-08-10T10:00)' }; const end = toolInput.end ? String(toolInput.end).trim() : null; const category = normCat(toolInput.category); const allDay = toolInput.allDay ? 1 : 0; const location = toolInput.location ? String(toolInput.location).trim() : null; const description = toolInput.description ? String(toolInput.description).trim() : null; const actionType = normAct(toolInput.actionType); const actionRef = toolInput.actionRef ? String(toolInput.actionRef).trim() : null; const actionPayload = toolInput.actionPayload ? String(toolInput.actionPayload) : null; const cronjobId = (toolInput.cronjobId === null || toolInput.cronjobId === undefined) ? null : Number(toolInput.cronjobId); const rows = await s.query('INSERT INTO events (title, category, start, end, all_day, location, description, action_type, action_ref, action_payload, cronjob_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING *', [title, category, start, end, allDay, location, description, actionType, actionRef, actionPayload, cronjobId, now, now]); return { added: true, event: rows[0] }; } if (action === 'update') { const id = Number(toolInput.id); if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) return { error: 'valid id is required for action=update' }; const existing = await s.query('SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = ?', [id]); if (!existing.length) return { error: 'no event with id ' + id }; const cur = existing[0]; const title = toolInput.title !== undefined ? String(toolInput.title).trim() : cur.title; const category = toolInput.category !== undefined ? normCat(toolInput.category) : cur.category; const start = toolInput.start !== undefined ? String(toolInput.start).trim() : cur.start; const end = toolInput.end !== undefined ? (toolInput.end ? String(toolInput.end).trim() : null) : cur.end; const allDay = toolInput.allDay !== undefined ? (toolInput.allDay ? 1 : 0) : cur.all_day; const location = toolInput.location !== undefined ? (toolInput.location ? String(toolInput.location).trim() : null) : cur.location; const description = toolInput.description !== undefined ? (toolInput.description ? String(toolInput.description).trim() : null) : cur.description; const actionType = toolInput.actionType !== undefined ? normAct(toolInput.actionType) : cur.action_type; const actionRef = toolInput.actionRef !== undefined ? (toolInput.actionRef ? String(toolInput.actionRef).trim() : null) : cur.action_ref; const actionPayload = toolInput.actionPayload !== undefined ? (toolInput.actionPayload ? String(toolInput.actionPayload) : null) : cur.action_payload; const cronjobId = toolInput.cronjobId !== undefined ? (toolInput.cronjobId === null ? null : Number(toolInput.cronjobId)) : cur.cronjob_id; const rows = await s.query('UPDATE events SET title = ?, category = ?, start = ?, end = ?, all_day = ?, location = ?, description = ?, action_type = ?, action_ref = ?, action_payload = ?, cronjob_id = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? RETURNING *', [title, category, start, end, allDay, location, description, actionType, actionRef, actionPayload, cronjobId, now, id]); return { updated: true, event: rows[0] }; } if (action === 'delete') { const id = Number(toolInput.id); if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) return { error: 'valid id is required for action=delete' }; const existing = await s.query('SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = ?', [id]); await s.exec('DELETE FROM events WHERE id = ?', [id]); return { deleted: true, id, event: existing[0] || null }; } if (action === 'get') { const id = Number(toolInput.id); if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) return { error: 'valid id is required for action=get' }; const rows = await s.query('SELECT * FROM events WHERE id = ?', [id]); return { event: rows[0] || null }; } if (action === 'upcoming') { const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(toolInput.limit) || 10, 1), 100); const rows = await s.query('SELECT * FROM events WHERE (end IS NOT NULL AND end >= ?) OR (end IS NULL AND start >= ?) ORDER BY start ASC LIMIT ?', [now, now, limit]); return { count: rows.length, events: rows }; } const from = toolInput.from ? String(toolInput.from).trim() : null; const to = toolInput.to ? String(toolInput.to).trim() : null; const catFilter = toolInput.category && cats.includes(String(toolInput.category)) ? String(toolInput.category) : null; const where = []; const args = []; if (from) { where.push('start >= ?'); args.push(from); } if (to) { where.push('start <= ?'); args.push(to); } if (catFilter) { where.push('category = ?'); args.push(catFilter); } const sql = 'SELECT * FROM events' + (where.length ? ' WHERE ' + where.join(' AND ') : '') + ' ORDER BY start ASC LIMIT 1000'; const rows = await s.query(sql, args); return { count: rows.length, events: rows };
